question: Owner 2026-10-26: booklet and paper track for the highest win-rate spike rule; how many backtest trades and detailed statistics.

rule.name: spike-HW v1 (插针高胜率版)
rule.entry: limit at the NY Monday 1.618, first weekly touch per side, alts; frozen entry score >= 0.6; 15m EMA order score >= 3
rule.confirm: next 60m candle close: back inside -> breakeven stop, otherwise exit at that close
rule.stop: -18 percent backstop from fill until confirmation
rule.sizing: 10 slots x 5x: margin = realized equity / 10, notional = 5 x margin, at most 10 open; floating loss >= 19 percent liquidates the slot margin
rule.fees: maker 0.02 percent (entry, target), taker 0.05 percent (stops, exits), 10bp slippage on non-target exits

in_sample: The order filter and the stop were chosen on the same history; forward paper data is the test.
